$comment: Issue 398: what a pull request runs besides jest --findRelatedTests (scripts/affected-tests.mjs).
everything: a changed file matching one of these runs every test (shared shell, kit, request guard, packages, jest and test setup, CI, the selector itself).

smoke: always run on a pull request: the server boots and answers (server-smoke), every page loads in a browser (report-every-page), every asset and route is served and classified (ui-assets, route-classes).

rules: when a changed file matches `when`, the tests matching `run` go too. Page rules come from how browser specs load pages (the URL each opens, and the public/*.js each page loads, transitively); the rest are tests that read files by path, which jest import graph cannot see.

A rule may also name `importers` (helper files: the tests that import them, by jest import graph, run too) and `mentions` (the browser specs that name a changed catalog key or its English text run too).
tests/fixtures/ci-replay-cases.json holds the real CI failures of the replay (scripts/ci-replay.mjs); tests/unit/test-infra/affected-tests.test.ts fails if this map stops catching one.

Issue 708: a test that starts Den as a process (bin/den, tsx on an entry, startDenServer) runs when its subject changes: the src files named like it, the src files it names, and the globs `subjects` gives it ({test: [globs]}). `subjectless` lists the ones with none yet; it only shrinks, and the selector test fails on a new one.
